sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: The Graph RAG ecosystem has converged around four major infrastructure pillars: **Microsoft GraphRAG** (CLI-driven pipeline producing Parquet artifacts with community reports, best for structured enterprise corpora), **LightRAG-HKU** (dual-level retrieval with relationship embeddings, best for dynamic knowledge with frequent updates), **LlamaIndex PropertyGraphIndex** (composable Python SDK with pluggable storage backends, best for teams already using LlamaIndex), and **LangChain-Neo4j** (`GraphCypherQAChain`, best for developers who want Graph RAG within an existing LangChain agent stack). There is also **Neo4j's official `neo4j-graphrag-python` library** which provides a `SimpleKGPipeline` for end-to-end extraction→storage→retrieval within Neo4j, and is the right choice when Neo4j is already the organisation's primary database. The choice between frameworks is driven by five axes: **corpus update frequency** (static → MS GraphRAG; dynamic → LightRAG), **team stack** (LangChain-first vs LlamaIndex-first), **query pattern** (global thematic vs local factual), **cost sensitivity** (LightRAG supports local LLMs), and **compliance requirements** (on-premises graph storage).

```
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

  │  │             │              │              │                │   │
  │  │ graphrag    │ rag.ainsert()│ from_docs()  │ Neo4jGraph +   │   │
  │  │ index       │ real-time    │ composable   │ Cypher QA      │   │
  │  │             │ updates      │ pipeline     │                │   │
  │  │ Best for:   │ Best for:    │ Best for:    │ Best for:      │   │
  │  │ Static      │ Dynamic      │ LlamaIndex   │ LangChain      │   │
  │  │ enterprise  │ low-cost     │ agents       │ agents         │   │
  │  └─────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┴────────────────┘   │

  │  │                STORAGE LAYER                                 │  │
  │  │  Graph DB: Neo4j / NetworkX / Amazon Neptune / ArangoDB      │  │
  │  │  Vector:   FAISS IVFFlat / LanceDB / Milvus / Neo4j Vector  │  │
  │  │  Cache:    Redis (entity/BFS/answer) TTL=1h-24h             │  │
  │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
  │         │                                                          │
  │         ▼                                                          │
  │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
  │  │                 QUERY LAYER                                  │  │
  │  │  local / global / hybrid / naive / drift / cypher            │  │
  │  │  → Context builder → LLM (gpt-4o-mini / Ollama / vLLM)     │  │
  │  │  → Answer + citations                                        │  │
  │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
  │                                                                     │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  DECISION MATRIX (quick reference)

  Update freq   | Query type  | Stack    | → Framework
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  static        | thematic    | any      | MS GraphRAG
  real-time     | factual     | any      | LightRAG-HKU
  any           | structured  | langchain| LangChain-Neo4j
  any           | hybrid      | llamaindex| LlamaIndex PropGraph
  any           | any         | neo4j    | neo4j-graphrag-python
  on-prem/cheap | any         | any      | LightRAG + Ollama
```
